options.content:
Manual explorer · Choose one exact benchmark scenario and compare its runs.
Default viewsManual

REFERENCE RUN · BEFORE
Open run details →
The comparison point. All changes below are measured from this run.
$baseline_ref
ROS $baseline_distro · version $baseline_version · run $baseline_run

NEW RUN · AFTER
Open run details →
The result being evaluated. Red signals mean this run became worse.
$candidate_ref
ROS $candidate_distro · version $candidate_version · run $candidate_run

panels.title: Workload status · worst result across every applicable KPI

panels.description: Report evidence is calculated independently for the selected topology; otherwise this shows the legacy threshold-only verdict. N/A categories are excluded and incomplete data cannot produce a passing result.
panels.title: Overall status

panels.description: Worst applicable mean or p95 latency increase. Possible regression at 0.5%; regression at 2%.
panels.title: Latency

panels.description: Worst applicable throughput decrease. Possible regression at 0.5%; regression at 2%. Service benchmarks report N/A.
panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Worst applicable peak CPU or RSS increase. Possible regression at 1%; regression at 5%.
panels.title: Resources

panels.description: Worst applicable lost-, late-, or too-late-message increase. Possible regression at 0.01 percentage points; regression at 0.1 percentage points. Service benchmarks report N/A.
panels.title: Reliability
Statistical evidence · selected category and uncertainty

panels.description: Statistical report uses repeat-aware evidence for the selected topology. Threshold-only is the legacy point-estimate review aid.
panels.title: Analysis method

panels.description: Number of paired measured trials used by the selected-topology comparison evidence.
panels.title: Measured pairs

panels.description: Worst adverse point estimate within the selected topology and category; units follow the report threshold.
panels.title: Effect estimate

panels.description: Selected-topology lower and upper bounds at the report confidence level.
panels.title: Confidence interval

panels.description: Possible and supported regression boundaries for the selected category.
panels.title: Practical thresholds
Selected scenario signals · new run change from reference

panels.description: Negative is better: the candidate reduced mean latency.
panels.title: Mean latency Δ

panels.description: Negative is better: the candidate reduced tail latency.
panels.title: p95 latency Δ

panels.description: Positive is worse: the candidate moved less data per second.
panels.title: Throughput loss Δ

panels.description: Negative is better: the candidate used less peak CPU.
panels.title: CPU max Δ

panels.description: Negative is better: the candidate used less peak resident memory.
panels.title: RSS max Δ
Comparable results · exact values for the selected scenario
Regression scan by payload · positive values are worse

panels.description: Percentage change in mean latency for the new run. Positive bars are regressions; negative bars are improvements.
panels.title: Mean latency regression

panels.description: Percentage change in p95 tail latency for the new run. Positive bars are regressions.
panels.title: p95 latency regression

panels.description: Percentage throughput loss in the new run. Positive bars mean throughput fell and are regressions.
panels.title: Throughput loss
Payload scaling · does the change behave consistently as messages grow?

panels.description: Mean latency for every available payload while keeping topology, process mode, RMW, and transport fixed.
panels.title: Mean latency by payload

panels.description: Pub/Sub throughput for every available payload under the same selected execution scenario.
panels.title: Throughput by payload
Tail and resource regressions · catch changes hidden by the mean

panels.description: Compares the latency distribution shape for the selected payload. A larger p95 or p99 gap indicates worse tail behavior even if the mean is stable.
panels.title: Latency percentile profile · selected payload

panels.description: Percentage change in peak CPU and RSS across payloads. Positive values mean the new run consumes more resources.
panels.title: Peak resource regression by payload
